  COUNT(*) as total_projects,
  SUM(JSON_LENGTH(images)) as total_gallery_images,
  COUNT(*) + SUM(JSON_LENGTH(images)) as total_images
FROM projects 
WHERE images IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALID(images);
